title: Trump raises tariffs on Canadian goods in response to Reagan advert
summary: Saying that airing the advert was a hostile act, Trump announced an additional 10% "over and above what they are paying now".

title: Netherlands' renewables drive putting pressure on its power grid
summary: Homes asked to use less electricity as network is overloaded by the rush to wind and solar power.

title: Trump to raise tariffs on Canada by 10% over Ontario’s Reagan ad
summary: US president was angered by a television advertisement quoting former president’s disdain for import levies

title: Trump Says He’ll Raise Canada Tariff by 10% After Reagan Ad
summary: President Donald Trump said he’s increasing US tariffs on Canada by 10% in response to an anti-tariff advertisement by the province of Ontario that is roiling one of the world’s biggest bilateral trade relationships.
